Name: Little Faeries
Author: Lavliette
Description:
[center][/center][left]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/KauZcc5.png[/img]﻿[font=Courier New][size=4]
[/size][/font][size=3][font=Courier New][/font][/size]

﻿[size=3][font=Courier New]Eight adorable faeries have come to the valley to live their life on your farm, bringing you their personal treasures.

Faeries only need a coop to be purchasable at Marnie's, they cost about 20,000 Gold, but if you treat them well, it's money well spent.


[b]
The faeries and their treasures:[/b]
[/font][font=Courier New]
[b]Air Faeries[/b] bring you fluffy [b]Wool[/b] and if they love you, they may sprinkle some [b]Fairy Dust
[/b][b]Dark Faeries[/b] ransack the mines at night for[b] Void Essence[/b] and [/font][/size][b][font=Courier New][size=3]Purple Slime Eggs[/size][/font]
[/b][size=3][font=Courier New][b]Fire Faeries[/b] love hot places and will bring you [b]Magma Caps[/b] and the elusive [/font][/size][b][font=Courier New][size=3]Cinder Shard[/size][/font]
[/b][size=3][font=Courier New][b]Grey Faeries[/b] mostly gather trash, but on a rare occasion you might find a [b]Prismatic Shard[/b] 
[size=3][font=Courier New][b]Ice Faeries[/b] follow the example of the Dark Faeries and gather[b] Frozen Tears[/b] and [b]Diamonds[/b][/font][/size][/font][/size]
[font=Courier New][size=3][b]Light Faeries[/b] love anything shiny and gather [b]Solar Essence[/b] and sometimes even a [b]Treasure Chest
[/b][/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=3][b]Water Faeries[/b] will bring the tropical [b]Blue Discus[/b] Fish to you and sometimes find a rare [b]Pearl [/b][/size][/font][/left][font=Courier New][size=3][b]Wood Faeries[/b] love to explore and gather [b]Mixed Seeds [/b]for you and they might even find a [b]Rare Seed


That's all there is to know. Hope you enjoy!

[/b][/size][/font]
